ThinkByte: Harsha Thota, Charan Kumar
Rubynathm
Sagniku
Key Takeaways
Evaluated the online sales funnel performance, noting a drop in conversion rates from checkout to purchase, now at 19% from 45% in June due to a influencer campaign.
Concerns were raised about recent changes to the checkout flow, particularly the new payment gateway potentially affecting conversion rates.
Discussed the need to capture customer phone numbers for enhanced engagement via SMS and WhatsApp, which historically yield better conversion rates than email.
Proposed including flyers with website information and discount codes in orders to drive online traffic without affecting sales from delivery platforms.
Acknowledged the need for training on the Pet Puja system for better management of menu items and improved communication with the Pet Puja team to streamline operations.

Review the "add to cart" feature as part of the latest focus on the funnel.
Check the drop in purchase percentage after a slow month to identify reasons for the substantial decrease.
Will update the group based on the conversation with Sudesh sir to try and execute the new design for Pet Puja screen to attract a new audience for Swiggism and others.

Key Metrics
The influencer campaign in June significantly boosted trust and intent to buy.
July experienced a decrease in conversion rates, but they still surpassed April and May levels due to the campaign's residual effects.
Checkout to purchase conversion rate is only 19%.
Previous months had higher conversion rates, with June showing 45%.
Success Stories
Resulted in the highest conversion rates observed in June.
Conversion Rates
Team should assess the checkout flow for potential issues.
SMS and WhatsApp typically have higher conversion rates compared to email.
Pain Points
There is no add to cart activity yet in the other two campaigns.
Recent changes to the payment gateway may have introduced complexities.
Found handling payment data difficult, prompting a decision to change the approach.
The sharing of emails is currently happening during the registration process.
Drop-off rates are high, particularly at checkout.
New item additions can only be done through the Pet Puja team; it is not possible to do it at our end.
Improvement Areas
Establish clearer communication to handle changes without delays.
Customer Feedback
Capturing phone numbers should be optional rather than mandatory.
Priorities
Change sorting order to prioritize freshly prepared items for the first two weeks.
Highlight products based on time of day (e.g., breakfast items in the morning).
Streamline the ordering process by allowing customers to add additional items directly.
Business Goals
Incentivize food orders to explore our website for additional offerings.
Focus on driving online traffic without cannibalizing delivery sales.
Marketing Efforts
Include flyers with website address and discount coupons in every order.
Current Status
Include flyers with website info and coupon codes in every order.
Utilize popular product identifiers to guide customer choices, as the menu is extensive.
Streamline the add-on options by integrating them directly into the main item selections for easier access.
Resource Needs
Schedule training sessions to ensure team understands the system effectively.
Multiple sessions needed for better understanding of the system.
Training required on new Pet Puja system for menu items and add-ons.
Task Updates
Keshav should speak directly with the team for updates and operational streamlining.
